How the business policy contributes

The same Decision Policy v1 function powers the visible demo and the optional browser tool. Risk = network signal + 15 for unfamiliar merchant + 20 for new device + 15 for amount ≥ $500, capped at 100. Below 35: approve. From 35 to 69: verify. At 70 or above: block and offer recovery. These are illustrative thresholds, not bank-validated fraud rules.

After verification, “Yes, this was me” approves the synthetic purchase. “No, not me” blocks it and offers recovery. Wallet support determines whether simulated activation or an assisted-recovery result is available.
